action_names: 双手兽爪向前下方按动
撮合手从外向额头靠近
双手协同左右转动方向盘
双手从腹部向两侧拉开
action_details: 一手食指沿嘴角向下滑动，完成“口水”过程。
双手拇指和食指从喉部两边同时向外移出，表示发声。
双手虚握、虎口相对、手背向上，形成准备状态。
双手向前推动，进入选购动作。
从虚握状态向左侧抓取商品。
从左侧返回并向右侧抓取商品。
第二次向左侧抓取商品。
第二次向右侧抓取商品。
抓取完成后回到双手虚握状态。
保持船头形状并向前行驶。
建立乘车握把手的准备状态。
虚握的手随公交车运动前后移动第一次。
虚握的手完成第二次前后移动。
先在前额形成老虎王字花纹。
随后双手弯曲五指并向前下方有力按动。
一手撮合、指尖朝上形成花苞准备。
手向上移动的同时逐渐张开，完成绽放。
拇指和食指撮合放在嘴前形成鸟喙。
双手食指和拇指组成鸡蛋大小的椭圆。
双手分开，完成打开鸡蛋的动作。
双手收起拇指、平摊四指，建立签子形状。
双手左右翻动完成第一次翻转。
双手左右翻动完成第二次翻转。
两个K手形交替向前绕圈，表示科学交流。
五指撮合、指尖朝内，从外部向额头靠近。
将撮合手按向额头，完成知识进入脑袋的动作。
一手模仿牛角，抵在太阳穴表示牛。
虎口朝上、五指弯曲，同时挤压并向下移动。
先建立两个拇指人头的相对关系。
两个拇指头互相碰撞第一次。
两个拇指头互相碰撞第二次。
双手建立方向盘握持准备状态。
双手共同完成左右转动。
一手五指成方块形，建立车身侧面。
保持车身形状向前移动一次。
先摆出手语仿字“人”。
从胸前出发顺时针转动一圈表示多人。
在一个位置完成一次树形动作。
在第二个不同位置完成一次树形动作。
在第三个不同位置完成一次树形动作。
右手食指和中指模拟双腿并先弯曲蓄力。
右手两指快速伸直并向上弹跳。
右手沿左手竖直食指由上向下完成剥皮。
拇指和食指平着用力拉开，表示把胆撑大。
双手向两侧分开形成月亮动作过程。
右手食指相对左手拇指人头完成向左指挥。
右手食指相对左手拇指人头完成向右指挥。
action_names_en: Slide the index finger down from the mouth corner
Move both hands outward from the throat
Rock forward and back — first time
Rock forward and back — second time
Form the tiger mark at the forehead
Press both claw hands forward and down
Alternate forward circles with two K shapes
Bring a gathered hand toward the forehead
Place a horn shape at the temple
Turn the wheel left and right
Form the side of a car
Peel downward along the banana finger
Pull both hands outward from the abdomen
action_details_en: One index finger travels downward along the mouth corner to complete the drool action.
Thumb-and-index hand shapes move outward from both sides of the throat to suggest vocalization.
Both hands form an imaginary handle with the web spaces facing each other and backs of hands upward.
Both hands move forward into the shopping action.
Reach from the grip toward an item on the left.
Return from the left and reach toward an item on the right.
Reach left for the second time.
Reach right for the second time.
Return to the two-hand cart grip after the reaches.
Keep the bow shape while travelling forward.
Establish the hand-grip posture for riding a bus.
Rock the gripping hand once with the bus motion.
Complete a second forward-backward rock.
Create the tiger-mark shape at the forehead first.
Then bend all fingers into claws and press forward and downward with emphasis.
Gather one hand with fingertips up to establish the bud.
Move upward while gradually opening the fingers to complete the bloom.
Pinch thumb and index finger in front of the mouth as a bird beak.
Use both index fingers and thumbs to form an egg-sized oval.
Separate both hands to complete the cracking action.
Fold both thumbs in and spread four fingers to establish the skewer shape.
Turn both hands side to side once.
Complete a second side-to-side turn.
Two K-like hand shapes alternate in forward circles.
Bring a gathered hand, fingertips inward, from outside toward the forehead.
Press the gathered hand to the forehead to complete the knowledge gesture.
Place one horn-like hand at the temple to represent a cow.
Keep the web space up, bend the fingers, and squeeze downward together.
Establish the relative position of the two thumb-heads.
Bring the two thumb-heads together once.
Bring them together a second time.
Establish the two-hand steering-wheel grip.
Both hands turn the wheel together from side to side.
Use one hand to form a block-like car side.
Keep the car shape while moving forward once.
First form the character-like shape for a person.
Start at the chest and circle clockwise once to suggest many people.
Complete one tree action at the first location.
Complete one tree action at a second location.
Complete one tree action at a third location.
Bend the right index and middle fingers as legs to load the jump.
Quickly extend the two fingers and jump upward.
Move the active hand from top to bottom along the upright reference index finger.
Pull the thumb-and-index shapes outward to show making the courage bigger.
Separate both hands to create the moon movement.
Direct left with the active index finger relative to the supporting thumb-head.
Direct right relative to the supporting thumb-head.
